title: The Future of Smart Glass Facades in Megaprojects
excerpt: Discover how modern glass technology achieves critical thermal insulation and smart lighting in luxury skyscrapers.
content: Modern structural glazing has transcended pure aesthetics, evolving into key functional envelopes that manage energy. This deep dive reviews electrochromic innovations, low-iron transparency parameters, and high-wind structural glass performance metrics across Saudi Arabia's mega structures.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Signing of Phase II for the Riyadh International Tower Facades
excerpt: Al-Fahd Contracting secures the major installation and cladding agreement for Riyadh's prominent landmark.
content: Al-Fahd Contracting has officially signed the phase II contract to customize and erect the double-glazed engineered aluminum cladding for the Riyadh International Tower, a masterwork of modern structural architecture.
author: Al-Fahd Management

title: Thermal Insulation Impact on Facade Energy Consumption in Desert Climates
excerpt: An analytical research on optimizing thermal break profiles for sustainable HVAC load reduction in KSA.
content: This comprehensive architectural research evaluates the synergy of low-E thermal breaks and insulated glass units in mitigating harsh UV radiation, allowing substantial peak-electricity usage savings.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Aluminum Curtain Wall Systems: Choosing the Right Type for Commercial Towers
excerpt: A comprehensive technical comparison of curtain wall system types and how to select the best fit for your project under Vision 2030 standards.
content: Aluminum curtain wall systems form the backbone of modern commercial tower design. They combine structural lightness, high durability, and superior thermal performance. This article compares Stick, Unit, and Semi-Unitized systems, explaining how each impacts installation cost and project timeline.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Wind Load Calculations for Steel Structures: ASCE Standards in Saudi Arabia
excerpt: A practical guide for structural engineers on applying ASCE 7 wind load standards to steel structures in the Saudi environment.
content: Wind loads are among the most critical forces affecting steel structure safety, especially in coastal areas like Jeddah and Dammam. This article explains how to apply ASCE 7-22 standards locally, with practical examples from Al-Fahd Contracting projects and design verification methods.
author: Eng. Ahmed Al-Shamri

title: Facade Engineering in NEOM: Future Challenges and Innovation Opportunities
excerpt: How NEOM's gigaprojects are redrawing the map of facade engineering in the Kingdom and opening new horizons for specialist contractors.
content: NEOM represents an unprecedented platform for innovation in facade engineering. From THE LINE's linear system to TROJENA's mountain terrain, these projects require facade solutions that go beyond traditional standards. We cover the key technical challenges and sustainability requirements that facade companies face in these historic projects.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: The Importance of ISO Certifications in Saudi Specialty Contracting
excerpt: How ISO 9001 and 45001 certifications strengthen the competitiveness of contracting firms and unlock access to major government contracts.
content: International quality certifications have become a prerequisite for qualifying in government and semi-government tenders in Saudi Arabia. Al-Fahd Contracting shares its experience obtaining ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, and the practical benefits of implementing quality standards across the entire workflow.
author: Quality Management — Al-Fahd

title: Low-Iron Glass: The First Choice for Luxury Showrooms
excerpt: Exploring the properties of Ultra-Clear low-iron glass and how it achieves perfect crystal transparency for automotive and jewelry showroom facades.
content: Low-iron glass achieves a light transmission rate exceeding 91% compared to 83% for standard glass, giving it that distinctive crystal clarity. In the Rolls-Royce Riyadh showroom project, we used 12mm low-iron glass units with a Spider system to achieve a facade completely free of any distracting green tint.
author: Eng. Saad Al-Otaibi

title: Construction Sector in Vision 2030: Opportunities and Requirements
excerpt: An analytical look at the radical transformations in the specialty contracting sector in light of Saudi Vision 2030 targets and sustainability requirements.
content: Saudi Vision 2030 targets raising the private sector's contribution to GDP to 65%, which means enormous opportunities for specialty contracting firms. We cover the key urban development programs, their sustainability standards, localization of materials and technical workforce requirements.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Ornamental Iron in Saudi Architecture: Reviving Heritage with a Modern Touch
excerpt: How Al-Fahd Contracting uses modern manufacturing technologies to produce ornamental ironwork inspired by Saudi architectural heritage.
content: Ornamental ironwork in luxury residential projects combines the aesthetics of traditional Islamic art with the precision of contemporary engineering. In the Al-Naseem Private Villa project in Khobar, laser cutting technology was used to produce Islamic decorative patterns with ±0.1mm precision, with powder coating treatment to ensure durability in the coastal atmosphere.
author: Eng. Khalid Al-Zahrani

title: SASO Standards for Facade Materials: Glass, Aluminum & Steel
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to SASO requirements for facade materials and how Al-Fahd Contracting ensures full compliance across all projects.
content: The Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization (SASO) issues strict standards governing the quality of building materials used in facades. This article reviews the key SASO requirements for safety glass, tempered glass, structural aluminum, and steel structures, explaining how we ensure full compliance from material procurement through final handover.
author: Quality Control Team — Al-Fahd

title: BIM Facade Coordination: How We Eliminate Clashes Before Construction
excerpt: A practical look at how Building Information Modeling eliminates costly facade clashes with structural and MEP systems before breaking ground.
content: BIM technology is revolutionizing how facade systems are coordinated with structural frameworks and mechanical/electrical installations. In the Industrial Innovation Complex at Jubail, using BIM Level 3 saved 18% in costs by catching clashes early and eliminating field change orders.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Sustainable Facades at Red Sea Global: A Lesson in Green Engineering
excerpt: How Al-Fahd Contracting met Red Sea Global's stringent sustainability requirements using eco-friendly materials and innovative design solutions.
content: The Red Sea Global project is one of the world's most sustainability-committed tourism developments. Al-Fahd Contracting delivered facade solutions using 75% recycled low-carbon aluminum and LEED-certified environmentally processed glass, contributing to the project's LEED Platinum rating.
author: Al-Fahd Management

title: Spider Glass Structural Systems: Full Transparency Without Frames
excerpt: An in-depth technical review of point-fixed glass systems and how they achieve frameless facades while maintaining the highest structural safety standards.
content: Spider Glass systems enable the construction of frameless glass facades by connecting glass panes through point-fixed fittings attached to a rear steel structure. This article covers system components, structural calculations for wind and seismic loads, and acceptance testing procedures per ASTM E1300 and EN 13022.
author: Eng. Fahad Al-Dosari

title: KAFD Smart Pedestrian Bridge: The Urban Engineering Challenge
excerpt: The story of executing the steel pedestrian bridge at King Abdullah Financial District — from design to handover, combining laser cutting with heavy structures.
content: The Smart Pedestrian Bridge at KAFD represented a genuine engineering challenge combining aesthetic design requirements with strict structural safety standards and tight delivery deadlines. We trace the project journey from detailed BIM design through field execution with installation loads of ≥500 tonnes.
author: Al-Fahd Management

title: Powder Coating vs. Anodizing: Which is Better for Exterior Aluminum Projects?
excerpt: A scientific comparison of the two most widely used aluminum surface treatment technologies and how each affects facade durability and long-term maintenance costs.
content: Surface treatment is one of the key factors determining the service life of aluminum in external facades. Powder coating with Qualicoat Class 2 provides superior UV resistance, while 25-micron anodizing offers higher resistance to mechanical scratching. We review selection criteria based on project location and environmental conditions.
author: Eng. Noura Al-Ghamdi

title: Fire-Rated Glass: Standards and Applications in High-Rise Buildings
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to fire-rated glass types and how to select the appropriate rating per the Saudi Fire Protection Code and UL 9 standard.
content: Fire-rated glass has become a mandatory requirement in many tower and commercial complex projects under the updated Saudi Building Code. This article covers the differences between EW and EI categories, testing requirements per EN 13501-2, and how to select the right type for each facade position while preserving aesthetic requirements.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Aluminum Extrusions: Achieving Micrometric Precision in Manufacturing
excerpt: A journey inside the aluminum extrusion production line and how Al-Fahd ensures profiles meet the precise engineering tolerances demanded by large-scale facades.
content: Aluminum facade quality begins with the extrusion profiles long before they reach the installation site. In our major projects, we work with certified aluminum extrusion factories using CNC dies with ±0.05mm precision, and every batch undergoes engineering tolerance testing and bending pressure measurements before shipment.
author: Eng. Abdullah Al-Rashid

title: Marine-Grade Aluminum in Coastal Projects: The Jubail Case Study
excerpt: How Al-Fahd Contracting handles the unique challenges of coastal chemical and saline environments in large-scale industrial aluminum projects.
content: Coastal and industrial environments impose exceptional challenges on aluminum facade systems due to salt corrosion and chemical emissions. In the Industrial Innovation Complex at Jubail, we specified 6063-T6 marine-grade aluminum alloy with 25-micron anodizing and a two-component PVDF coating to guarantee a design life of no less than 25 years.
author: Eng. Mohammed Al-Anzi

title: Al Nakheel Mall Atrium: Achieving Total Transparency Across 12,000 m² Without Frames
excerpt: A detailed case study of the frameless glass atrium at Al Nakheel Mall in Jeddah — from the no-frame design challenge to final acceptance testing.
content: The Al Nakheel Mall atrium presented a rare engineering challenge requiring total optical transparency across 12,000 m² with no visible frames. We implemented a point-fixed Spider system using stainless steel fittings concealed behind precision structural notches, with 15mm monolithic tempered glass units tested to ±3.0 kPa wind load.
author: Al-Fahd Management

title: Sealant Selection for Facade Joints: An Applied Engineering Guide
excerpt: How project engineering properties determine the right sealant type and what test standards guarantee seal durability over twenty years.
content: Sealants form the critical link between glass and aluminum units in facades. Structural silicone tolerates dynamic deformations of up to ±25%, while weather-resistant silicone addresses thermal gaps and moisture protection. We compare ASTM C1184 and ISO 11600 compliant products and share our experience selecting the right material for each project.
author: Al-Fahd Engineering Team

title: Anti-Corrosion Coating Systems for Steel Structures in the Saudi Environment
excerpt: A comprehensive review of approved protective coating systems for preserving steel structures from corrosion across Saudi Arabia's varied environments.
content: Steel structure protection requirements vary by project location: inland desert environments demand protection from extreme temperatures and sandstorms, while coastal environments require salt corrosion resistance. We review the leading coating systems used in our projects per ISO 12944, comparing design lives and costs.
author: Eng. Sultan Al-Harthi

title: Project Management in Specialty Contracting: Al-Fahd's Experience Delivering 300+ Projects
excerpt: Lessons learned from managing over 300 specialty facade projects and Al-Fahd's methodology for guaranteeing on-time delivery without compromising quality.
content: Al-Fahd Contracting anchors its project management methodology on three pillars: precise planning using CPM/BIM, daily coordination through a centralized operations room, and triple-layer quality control. We share real examples from our projects where we successfully delivered facades exceeding 50,000 m² on schedule despite supply chain challenges.
author: Al-Fahd Management
